title: Tastebuds profile, format 1.1
description: One taste profile: an owner, and the entries the owner watches (taste references) or credits (inspirations).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

formatVersion.description: The version of the format the file is written in. A 1.x file is valid against any later 1.x schema.

entries.description: The entries of the profile. Entry ids must be unique; the validate script checks this, because JSON Schema cannot.

owner.description: Who the profile belongs to. Maps to a schema.org Person or Organization.

type.description: The schema.org type of the owner.

sameAs.description: The owner's own site and profiles. The first link is the main one.

credit.description: A piece of the owner's work that credits an inspiration.

entry.description: One entity in the profile, in one of two relations to the owner.

id.description: A short stable name for the entry, unique in the profile. It stays the same when the entry is renamed or moves from taste reference to inspiration.

kind.description: What the entity is. Each kind maps to one schema.org type; see schema/kinds.json. person: Person. studio: Organization. channel, book, work: CreativeWork.

relation.description: tasteReference: the owner watches this entity's taste and has taken nothing from it yet. inspiration: it gave something to the owner's work, and that work credits it.

sameAs.description: The entity's own site and profiles: site, YouTube, X, GitHub, and its Wikidata item when one exists. At least one, so the entity can be recognised elsewhere. The first link is the main one.

tags.description: Taste tags: short lower-case words for what the owner sees in this entity.

notes.description: The owner's own notes on the entry, in a small Markdown subset: paragraphs, a kept line break, **bold**, _italic_, [links](https://example.com/) and '- ' bullet lists. Nothing else is Markdown. Plain text from format 1.0 reads the same. See docs/features/editor-field.md.

added.description: The day the entry was added to the profile, as YYYY-MM-DD.

gave.description: Inspirations only: what the entity gave to the owner's work, in a sentence.

creditedIn.description: Inspirations only: the work that credits the entity. At least one.
